heading.en: Origins and the killing of the dictator

body.zh-Hant: 拉蒙·卡塞雷斯生於1866年12月15日，卒於1911年11月19日。他出身莫卡一個顯赫而富裕的家族，是地主，站在反對總統烏利塞斯·厄羅的前列。1899年7月26日，他在莫卡的一次公開露面中刺殺了這位獨裁者，因此贏得全國性的聲望。
body.en: Ramón Cáceres was born on 15 December 1866 and died on 19 November 1911. He came from a distinguished and prosperous family of Moca and was a landowner at the forefront of the opposition to president Ulises Heureaux. On 26 July 1899 he assassinated the dictator during a public appearance in Moca, which earned him national recognition.

heading.zh-Hant: 政局混亂、流亡與接任總統
heading.en: Chaos, exile and succession to the presidency

body.zh-Hant: 刺殺之後的政治混亂造成了數年不穩定的政權。卡塞雷斯在1903年被迫流亡，1904年返國，出任卡洛斯·莫拉萊斯手下的副總統；1906年莫拉萊斯放棄職位，由卡塞雷斯接任總統職務。
body.en: The political chaos that followed the assassination resulted in several years of unstable regimes. Cáceres was forced into exile in 1903 but returned in 1904 to become vice president under Carlos Morales. When Morales abandoned his post in 1906, Cáceres assumed the office.

citations.quote: The ensuing political chaos resulted in several years of unstable regimes
Cáceres was forced into exile in 1903 but returned in 1904
to become vice president under Carlos Morales
When the latter abandoned his post in 1906, Cáceres assumed the office.

body.zh-Hant: 卡塞雷斯的總統任期被認為是多明尼加歷史上最和平、最繁榮的時期之一。他擴大聯邦權力，卻不削弱地方政府；他修改憲法，展開雄心勃勃的公共工程計畫，並把許多私人擁有的公用事業轉為公有。
body.en: Cáceres's presidency was one of the most peaceful and prosperous periods in Dominican history. He expanded federal power without debilitating local government, reformed the constitution, began an ambitious public works program, and transferred many privately owned utilities to the public realm.

citations.quote: one of the most peaceful and prosperous periods in Dominican history

heading.zh-Hant: 政敵、美國海關監管與遇刺
heading.en: Enemies, the US customs receivership and the assassination

body.zh-Hant: 經濟權力的轉移為他樹立了有力的敵人，也出現過數起未遂的陰謀。1905年美國海關監管（receivership）建立，卡塞雷斯歡迎隨之而來的繁榮，卻仍擔心對美國的財政依賴。1911年他在傍晚騎馬時遇刺身亡；其後政經失序再現，最終導致1916年美國占領多明尼加共和國。
body.en: The shifts in economic power earned him powerful enemies, and there were several unsuccessful plots against his government. In 1905 a United States customs receivership was established; Cáceres welcomed the prosperity it brought but remained concerned about financial dependence on the United States. In 1911 he was assassinated during his evening ride, and the disorder that followed ultimately led to the U.S. occupation of the Dominican Republic in 1916.

people.name: Pehr Evind Svinhufvud
people.nameZh: 佩爾·埃溫德·斯溫胡武德

body.zh-Hant: 佩爾·埃溫德·斯溫胡武德1861年12月15日生於薩克斯馬基，1944年2月29日卒於盧馬基。他的父親是船長，在他兩歲時於希臘群島海域溺斃。他1878年16歲入大學，在土爾庫上訴法院逐步晉升，也曾當律師、開庭審案；31歲即被召為參政院法律籌備委員會成員。1894年他以家族首長身分首次參加國會（lantdag）貴族等級。
body.en: Pehr Evind Svinhufvud was born on 15 December 1861 in Sääksmäki and died on 29 February 1944 in Luumäki. His father, a sea captain, drowned in the Greek archipelago when he was two. He enrolled at the university in 1878 at the age of 16, advanced step by step in the Åbo court of appeal, worked as an advocate and sat at local courts, and at 31 was called to the Senate's law preparation committee. In 1894, as head of his family, he first took part in the Diet as a member of the estate of nobles.

heading.zh-Hant: 憲政抵抗與上訴法院事件
heading.en: Constitutional resistance and the court of appeal affair

body.zh-Hant: 1899年二月宣言開啟俄國同化芬蘭的進程後，斯溫胡武德成為堅定的憲政主義者。1902年有赫爾辛基市民就尼蘭省俄籍省長鎮壓反徵兵示威向上訴法院控告，法院對省長起訴；總督博布里科夫要求中止，並在未遂後解除土爾庫上訴法院16名官員職務。斯溫胡武德被視為抵抗的靈魂，其後在赫爾辛基當律師，並在領導消極抵抗的秘密組織卡加爾（Kagalen）中從事政治活動。
body.en: After the February Manifesto of 1899 began Russia's drive to integrate Finland, Svinhufvud became a thoroughgoing constitutionalist. In 1902 residents of Helsinki complained to the Åbo court of appeal about the violence used by the Russian governor of Nyland against a demonstration against the conscription call-up, and the court prosecuted the governor. Governor-General Nikolai Bobrikov demanded that the case be stopped and, when it was not, dismissed 16 officials of the court. Svinhufvud was regarded as the soul of the resistance; he then became an advocate in Helsinki and was politically active in the secret organization Kagalen, which led the passive resistance.

heading.zh-Hant: 國會議長與流放西伯利亞
heading.en: Speaker of the Diet and exile in Siberia

body.zh-Hant: 斯溫胡武德身為青年芬蘭黨政治人物，被選為首屆一院制國會的議長，因社會民主黨視他為「最知名的反違法者」。他1909年在國會開幕演說中批評呈報芬蘭事務的程序不合芬蘭法律，沙皇立即解散國會，翌年亦然；1913年社會民主黨改投自己人，他未獲連任。第一次世界大戰期間他拒絕執行自認違法的命令，被當庭逮捕，1914年被流放到西伯利亞托木斯克。
body.en: As a Young Finn politician Svinhufvud was elected speaker of the first unicameral Diet, because the Social Democrats saw him as the best-known opponent of illegality. At the opening of the 1909 Diet he criticised a procedure for presenting Finland's affairs that was incompatible with Finland's laws; the Emperor dissolved the Diet at once, and did so again the following year. In 1913 the Social Democrats voted for their own man and Svinhufvud was not re-elected. During the First World War he refused orders he regarded as illegal, was arrested in the courtroom and in 1914 was banished to Tomsk in Siberia.

heading.en: Independence in 1917 and the start of the 1918 war

body.zh-Hant: 俄國三月革命的消息傳到流放地後，斯溫胡武德返國，受到民族英雄式歡迎；臨時政府4月3日任命他為檢察總長（prokurator）。11月27日所謂獨立參政院選出，他以主席即總理身分宣布獨立；12月31日他親赴彼得格勒見列寧，蘇維埃政府1918年1月4日正式承認。1918年1月底社會主義者發動革命後，他先在赫爾辛基地下領導參政院，3月初搭破冰船塔爾莫逃出，經塔林前往柏林。
body.en: When news of the Russian March revolution reached him in exile, Svinhufvud returned home and was hailed as a national hero; on 3 April 1917 the provisional government appointed him prokurator. On 27 November the so-called independence senate was elected, in which he as chairman, that is prime minister, proclaimed independence; on the last day of the year he visited Lenin in Petrograd, and the Soviet government officially recognised independence on 4 January 1918. After the socialists proclaimed revolution at the end of January 1918 he first led the Senate underground in Helsinki, escaped in early March on the icebreaker Tarmo and went via Reval to Berlin.

body.zh-Hant: 1918年5月18日斯溫胡武德被選為「最高權力行使者」，即臨時國家元首、攝政，任命帕西基維為總理並主持外交。他在秋季赦免了逾3.6萬名紅軍囚犯。他親赴柏林，請德皇威廉二世讓其子奧斯卡出任芬蘭國王；德國戰敗後他於12月10日宣布辭去攝政，議會12月12日批准，12月17日他又獲准辭去檢察總長職務。
body.en: On 18 May 1918 Svinhufvud was elected 'exerciser of the supreme power', that is provisional head of state and regent; he appointed J. K. Paasikivi prime minister and took over the leadership of foreign policy. In the autumn he pardoned over 36,000 Red prisoners. He travelled to Berlin to ask Kaiser Wilhelm II to let his son Oskar become king of Finland. After Germany's defeat he announced on 10 December his resignation as regent, the Diet approved it on 12 December, and on 17 December he was granted dismissal from his post as prokurator.

heading.zh-Hant: 私人生活、護國團與總理任期
heading.en: Private life, the Civil Guard and the premiership

body.zh-Hant: 卸任後他曾在土爾庫擔任信貸機構Suomen Vakuus Oy的董事總經理，之後領國家年金退居盧馬基。他加入護國團，也是國民聯合黨（Kokoomus）的普通黨員，該黨1925年提名他為總統候選人，他得到68張選舉人票。1930年總統萊蘭德召他任總理；他的路線是一面剷除共產主義、一面維持法治，政府下令逮捕所有共產黨議員，改選後資產階級各派取得通過反共法所需的三分之二多數。
body.en: After leaving state service he was for some years managing director of the credit institution Suomen Vakuus Oy in Åbo, and then retired on a state pension to Luumäki. He joined the Civil Guard and was an ordinary member of the National Coalition Party, which nominated him as its candidate in the 1925 presidential election, where he received 68 electors. In 1930 President Relander called him to be prime minister; his line was to eradicate communism while upholding the legal order, the government had all communist members of parliament arrested, and after the new election the bourgeois groups obtained the two-thirds majority needed to approve the laws.

body.zh-Hant: 1931年總統選舉他代表跨黨派的選舉聯盟參選，第三輪在農民聯盟支持下以151票對前總統史塔爾貝里的149票當選。他上任後首先請曼納海姆擔任國防委員會主席。1932年2月底至3月初的曼采拉叛亂中，他接掌政府、軍隊與護國團的作戰指揮，並以廣播演說促使叛亂者放棄。1937年他在第一輪只得94票，社會民主黨轉而支持卡利歐，後者當選。
body.en: In the presidential election of 1931 he stood for an electoral alliance that crossed party lines, and in the third round, with the Agrarian League behind him, he was elected with 151 votes against former president K. J. Ståhlberg's 149. His first act as president was to call Mannerheim to chair the renewed Defence Council. During the Mäntsälä revolt at the turn of February and March 1932 he took over the operational leadership of the government, the army and the Civil Guard, and a radio speech helped break the revolt. In 1937 he received only 94 votes in the first round; the Social Democrats shifted their support to Kyösti Kallio, who was elected.

body.zh-Hant: 冬季戰爭末期，他前往德國爭取對芬蘭的支持，但希特勒拒絕接見，墨索里尼在羅馬也一樣；他只見到教宗庇護十二世。1943年他小量出版《民族綱領》，提出以主動戰爭建立大芬蘭的計畫。他的葬禮於1944年3月舉行，會上強調他對蘇聯的堅決不退讓。
body.en: At the end of the Winter War he travelled to Germany to obtain support for Finland, but Hitler refused to receive him, and so did Mussolini in Rome; he did meet Pope Pius XII. In 1943 he published in a small edition the pamphlet Kansallinen ohjelma, which presented a plan for creating a Greater Finland through active warfare. At his funeral in March 1944 his unyielding stance towards the Soviet Union was emphasised.

body.zh-Hant: 羅克·薩恩斯·佩尼亞生於1851年3月19日，屬阿根廷上層階級；其父路易斯曾任阿根廷總統（1892至1895年）。他在布宜諾斯艾利斯大學攻讀法律，1874年曾短暫中斷學業，加入鎮壓前總統米特雷所領導叛亂的部隊；1875年畢業，一年後以自治國民黨（Partido Autonomista Nacional）代表的身分當選布宜諾斯艾利斯省議會議員。
body.en: Roque Sáenz Peña was born on 19 March 1851 into the Argentine upper class; his father Luis was president of Argentina (1892-1895). He studied law at the University of Buenos Aires, interrupted his studies briefly in 1874 to join the forces suppressing a rebellion led by former President Bartolomé Mitre, graduated in 1875, and a year later was elected to the Buenos Aires legislature representing the Partido Autonomista Nacional.

body.zh-Hant: 1879年太平洋戰爭爆發後，薩恩斯·佩尼亞前往利馬，加入秘魯與玻利維亞對智利的同盟。他以勇敢聞名，參加了聖法蘭西斯科與塔拉帕卡之戰，也參與阿里卡的英勇防禦，1880年在阿里卡被俘。
body.en: When the War of the Pacific broke out in 1879, Sáenz Peña moved to Lima and joined the alliance of Peru and Bolivia against Chile. He became known for his bravery, took part in the battles of San Francisco and Tarapacá and in the heroic defense of Arica, where he was taken prisoner in 1880.

body.zh-Hant: 返回阿根廷後，他先任外交部次長，1887年8月獲任派駐烏拉圭的特使兼全權公使，1888年是阿根廷出席蒙特維多南美國際私法會議的代表團成員，次年參加華盛頓的泛美會議。1890年他短暫出任外交部長，因1890年7月26日的革命而辭職。1891年他一度成為總統候選人，後在羅卡與米特雷安排其父參選後退出；1892年12月他辭去參議員職務，退居恩特雷里奧斯省的牧場。
body.en: After returning to Argentina he was named undersecretary of the Ministry of Foreign Relations; in August 1887 he was appointed special envoy and minister plenipotentiary to Uruguay, in 1888 sat on the Argentine delegation at the South American Conference of Private International Law in Montevideo, and a year later took part in the Pan-American Conference in Washington. In 1890 he served briefly as minister of foreign relations and had to resign after the revolution of 26 July 1890. In 1891 he became a presidential candidate but withdrew when Roca and Mitre engineered his father's candidacy; he resigned from the Senate in December 1892 and retired to an estancia in Entre Ríos.

heading.zh-Hant: 改革派政治與當選總統前

body.zh-Hant: 1895年父親辭去總統後，他回到布宜諾斯艾利斯，從此開始抨擊腐敗、人身化的政治體制。自治國民黨的改革派在卡洛斯·佩萊格里尼領導下（直到1906年佩萊格里尼去世），在1906年與1908年的國會選舉中支持他。
body.en: He returned to Buenos Aires in 1895 after his father's resignation and from then on began attacking the corrupt, personalistic political system. The Reformista faction of the Partido Autonomista Nacional, headed by Carlos Pellegrini until his death in 1906, supported him in the congressional elections of 1906 and 1908.

heading.zh-Hant: 總統任期與薩恩斯·佩尼亞法
heading.en: The presidency and the Sáenz Peña Law

body.zh-Hant: 1910年他當選總統（1910至1914年在任）。1912年他發動選舉改革，該法即薩恩斯·佩尼亞法，規定投票為義務、採祕密投票，並保障少數黨在國會中的代表權。他於1914年8月9日去世。
body.en: In 1910 he was elected president (1910-1914). In 1912 he initiated an electoral reform law, the Sáenz Peña Law, which made voting compulsory and provided for the secret ballot and minority political representation in Congress. He died on 9 August 1914.

heading.en: Content and effects of the electoral law

body.zh-Hant: 薩恩斯·佩尼亞法也稱1912年法，要求阿根廷十八歲以上的本國及歸化男性一律投票，選民名冊以軍隊徵兵名單為基礎，少數黨可藉不完整名單取得每個選區三分之一議席。此法使投票率升至七到八成，1912年合格選民增至約百萬人；激進公民聯盟因而在1916年總統選舉獲勝，其領袖伊波利托·伊里戈延成為第一位不出身傳統統治階級的總統。
body.en: The Sáenz Peña Law, also known as the Law of 1912, made voting compulsory for all native and naturalized Argentine men over the age of 18, with the electoral roll based on the military's conscription lists, and let the party with the second-highest number of votes take one-third of the seats in each district through the incomplete list. Turnout rose to between 70 and 80 percent and the number of eligible voters reached 1 million in 1912; the Unión Cívica Radical won the presidential election of 1916 and its leader Hipólito Irigoyen became the first president who did not come from the traditional ruling class.
